relations.text: 2024年8月31日、IBMのQRadar事業の一部資産(知的財産、顧客関係、SaaS顧客契約)の買収を完了。IBMに条件付き対価を支払う
relations.text_en: Completed the acquisition of certain IBM QRadar assets (IP, customer relationships, SaaS customer contracts) on August 31, 2024, with contingent consideration payable to IBM

source.label: Palo Alto Networks 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: On August 31, 2024, we completed the acquisition of certain IBM QRadar assets, including certain intellectual property rights, customer relationships, and software as a service customer contracts.
source.note: 買収は2024年8月に完了済みで、2026年度の年次報告に記載されています。
source.note_en: The acquisition closed in August 2024; it is reported in the FY2026 10-K.
